title: Deeply nested image markup makes mistune recurse without a limit
body: Bug: converting the input '![' * 1000 + 'a' + '](u)' * 1000, and the same wrapped in a link '[' + '![' * 1000 + 'a' + '](u)' * 1000 + '](u)', takes far too long or overflows the stack, both to HTML and with renderer='ast'. Nesting of images must be bounded so such input finishes quickly, and the limit must be an attribute of the inline parser named max_image_depth (like the existing max_emphasis_depth), default 20, that can be read and changed when the parser is built.

acceptance.verify: PYTHONPATH=src mise exec pipx:pytest@9.2.0 -- pytest -q tests
